teaser: You close the till with both hands before anyone can ask if it balanced — a life path 8, an ISFJ, already checking the count twice because once isn't care, it's just arithmetic. The 8 wants command of the material world: money, standing, a room ordered to a purpose. The ISFJ wants no one to notice the hand that ordered it. Crossed, you get someone who runs the operation from the back room, who keeps the numbers right and the people fed, and who finds it strange when either one gets called ambition.
excerpt: A second coat, folded over your arm in a thrift store fitting room, waiting while someone decides if it fits — that patience is part of what an 8 paired with an ISFJ brings into a partnership.
